frequency_question: What proportion of officially proposed transport/manufacturing financial schemes successfully reach gazette notification within a 10-month window of initial structured signalling?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes in automotive, heavy industries, or transport sectors announced with draft or consultative frameworks that reach formal notification. Excludes minor budgetary line-item modifications and purely state-level initiatives.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage
Modified FAME-II outlay extensions / PM E-Drive Scheme
National Green Hydrogen Mission financial incentive schemes for transport

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major named schemes; universally successful once reaching the formal advance signal stage due to high-level cabinet backing.
known_gaps: Minor sub-schemes or delayed drafts that languished without formal notification are harder to systematically track in public repositories.
skeleton: Sectoral manufacturing policy initiatives under the Ministry of Heavy Industries and Ministry of Commerce that undergo inter-ministerial consultation
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 documented major comparable capital subsidy schemes in the sector reaching notification once formally advanced.
validity_reason: The procedural machinery and bureaucratic momentum for industrial subsidies in India remain stable under current administrative frameworks.
